title: Organization configuration pack
description: Reusable organization, persona, terminology, brand, and operational configuration. Core agent and workflow logic must read every organization-specific value from this contract. Harborlight is an example pack only. Environment-specific values are declared by variable name and are never carried as values here.

primaryWorkflow.description: Token {{PRIMARY_WORKFLOW}}. Option A locks this to the single shift-closeout workflow.

pilotLabel.description: Token {{PILOT_LABEL}}. Name the organization uses for the controlled pilot.

endUserRole.description: Token {{END_USER_ROLE}}. Display label for the end user.

authorizedRoleCodes.description: Role codes permitted to request a draft and to record a decision.

unitNoun.description: Token {{UNIT_NOUN}}. Unit, ward, floor, pod, or bay.

ehrSystemLabel.description: Token {{EHR_SYSTEM}}. In Option A this is always a synthetic simulator label.

shiftLabel.description: Token {{SHIFT_LABEL}}. Shift closeout, shift handoff, or end-of-shift report.

handoffFormatLabel.description: Token {{HANDOFF_FORMAT_LABEL}}. Name of the documented handoff structure the organization already uses. It is a referenced convention, not a standard endorsed by this accelerator.

approvalActionLabel.description: Token {{APPROVAL_ACTION_LABEL}}. Display verb only. The recorded decision value is fixed by contract.

brandAssetPath.description: Token {{BRAND_ASSET_PATH}}. Repository-relative path. Absolute paths and URLs are rejected.

syntheticOnly.description: Structural lock. An organization pack cannot declare a non-synthetic data source in this accelerator.

fhirDataPath.description: Token {{FHIR_DATA_PATH}}. Repository-relative path to the synthetic dataset.

maxRevisions.description: Maximum revision requests allowed in one run before the workflow fails closed.

maxContextAgeMs.description: Maximum age of patient and encounter confirmation at generation and approval gates.

groundingThreshold.description: Minimum acceptable grounding coverage ratio. Option A requires fully referenced output, so the only permitted value is 1.

auditRetentionLabel.description: Token {{AUDIT_RETENTION_LABEL}}. User-facing statement about how long evidence is kept in this demonstration.

mandatoryDraftPrefix.description: Non-removable prefix. An organization pack may extend the disclaimer body but can never replace or omit this prefix.

disclaimerBody.description: Token {{DISCLAIMER_TEXT_OVERRIDE}}. Organization-supplied disclaimer body rendered after the mandatory prefix. Required, so an empty configuration can never silently remove the disclaimer.

syntheticDataNotice.description: Token {{SYNTHETIC_DATA_NOTICE}}. User-facing confirmation that the data is synthetic.

errorMessageOverrides.description: Optional per-code user-visible message overrides. Keys are fail-closed codes.

illustrativeMetrics.description: Illustrative time-back sample figures for the simple demonstration view. Every figure here is a simulated sample value under human configuration control, never a measured outcome, and never an environment or secret value. The metric contract reads its baseline and assisted durations from this block so no figure is hardcoded in application code.

metricLabel.description: Structural lock. An organization pack cannot declare time-back figures under any other label.

baselineDurationMinutes.description: Illustrative duration of the unassisted shift-closeout workflow for this organization's demonstration scenario.

assistedDurationMinutes.description: Illustrative duration of the assisted shift-closeout workflow. Must not exceed baselineDurationMinutes; the illustrative-metrics-config-arithmetic cross-field rule checks this.

metricIdPrefix.description: Optional prefix used to mint the metricId shown in the view.

periodLabel.description: Optional label for the illustrative period, for example a synthetic pilot week.

sampleBasisNote.description: Human-readable statement of what the figures are and are not. The pattern requires the literal token ILLUSTRATIVE, so a pack cannot describe these figures as measured results.

environmentBindings.description: Maps logical environment settings to environment variable names. Values are supplied at run time from the environment and are never committed. Tokens {{AZURE_REGION}}, {{FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT}}, {{FOUNDRY_AGENT_ID}}, and {{COPILOT_ENVIRONMENT_ID}} resolve through this map.
